name: Gemini
powers: AI portrait builder (hairstyle, clothing, body type, framing, art style).
how: The browser asks this app's server, the server calls the Gemini API with the key from .env, and the image comes back to the screen.

name: ElevenLabs
powers: Narration in the two host voices, Mesa and Reed.
how: The server sends the script text to ElevenLabs text-to-speech and returns an MP3. The demo ships twelve clips made once ahead of time.

name: Hedra
powers: Talking-avatar video from a portrait plus narration audio.
how: The server uploads a portrait and an audio clip to Hedra and polls until the video is ready. No screen calls it yet; it is wired on the server for the finals.
